description: Reads a public RSS feed (or Apple/Spotify link, or a web page that links to its feed, such as a Vimeo channel) and lists its episodes with which are already on Podgist and the price to transcribe the rest. Episodes with video_page true are videos: they are priced, but ordering them needs a request to us. Free; no key needed; at most 10 a minute.
name: analyze_feed
title: Analyze a podcast feed for indexing
